label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameterNames() flows through Base64 encode/decode transformations to response.getWriter().format() which uses the tainted 'bar' variable as a format string argument. The Base64 operations do not sanitize or escape special characters needed for format string exploitation.

evidence.note: User input param extracted from request.getParameterNames() flows through Base64 encode/decode to bar variable which is passed to response.getWriter().format() as format string argument
